title: Payments data to 30 June 2026
what_it_supports: Shows nominal NDIS payments reached 51.5 billion dollars in the trailing 12 months
key_limit: Spending does not itself measure participant benefit

title: Participant datasets: baseline and longitudinal outcomes
what_it_supports: Tracks reported participant outcomes from Scheme entry to reassessment
key_limit: No denominators uncertainty estimates or non-NDIS counterfactual

title: Participant Outcomes Summary Report to 30 June 2024
what_it_supports: Shows statistically significant and material change in some domains alongside adverse or unchanged results
key_limit: Change over time is not proof that the Scheme caused the change

title: Evaluation of the NDIS: Final Report
study_design: Mixed-method independent trial evaluation with a comparison group
what_it_supports: Found scheme-level gains in choice and control and generally modest participant wellbeing gains
key_limit: Early trial sites with uneven effects and differential survey response

title: NDIS Review: Costs benefits and frameworks
study_design: NDIA outcome modelling plus HILDA longitudinal modelling
what_it_supports: Finds benefits in some participant and carer domains but null or mixed results in others
key_limit: Imperfect counterfactual small HILDA NDIS sample and assumption-dependent valuations

title: Working together to deliver the NDIS: Final Report
what_it_supports: Concludes current systems cannot adequately show what works for whom and why
key_limit: Expert synthesis rather than a causal impact study

title: Exploring the impact of a personalised disability reform on people with disability and their primary carers
what_it_supports: Tests short-run area-level effects on formal-service use and carer outcomes and finds no statistically significant effects
key_limit: Area availability is not confirmed receipt and the 1054-dyad sample had limited power
